def transform(grid):
    # recolor separate regions of the large 8 figure according to small key
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8]

    unseen=set(pts); comps=[]

        while todo:
            r,c=todo.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in unseen: unseen.remove(p); comp.add(p); todo.append(p)

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,8)]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    key=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    rotated=[list(row) for row in zip(*key[::-1])]
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8]
    top=min(r for r,c in cells); bottom=max(r for r,c in cells)
    left=min(c for r,c in cells); right=max(c for r,c in cells)
    bh=(bottom-top+1)//len(rotated); bw=(right-left+1)//len(rotated[0])
    for br,row in enumerate(rotated):
        for bc,color in enumerate(row):
            if color==0: continue
            for r in range(top+br*bh,top+(br+1)*bh):
                for c in range(left+bc*bw,left+(bc+1)*bw):
                    if grid[r][c]==8: out[r][c]=color
    return out
PY
